topic: fix a phone that's charging much slower than usual
core_question: Why is my phone charging so slowly, and how do I speed it back up? (secondary: How do you stop a door hinge from squeaking?)
answer_summary: Charge with the phone manufacturer's original (or a matching-wattage certified) power adapter and cable, since a mismatched or damaged one causes slow charging.; after the topic shift: Remove or tap up the hinge pin, apply a lubricant such as WD-40, white lithium grease, or household oil to the pin and hinge knuckles, work the door back and forth, then wipe off excess.
persona: impatient and curt; using casual slang
